title: Strieber writes to warn against the Oxford carbon dating of the shroud

tellings.quote: and I write Father Raldi a letter. Do not do this. They have to defend their paradigm. They will lie without knowing it. And they do bury that very thing. They say the shroud is from the middle ages. They destroy the research.

plain: In 1988 the author Whitley Strieber, who says he has met aliens, wrote to a priest named Father Raldi warning him not to let scientists at Oxford carbon-date the Shroud of Turin, a linen cloth some believe wrapped the body of Jesus. Strieber tells Jesse Michels he warned that the scientists would defend their way of thinking and "lie without knowing it". He says that is what happened: they dated the shroud to the Middle Ages and, in his words, destroyed the research.
